entries.feature: SDK `Split` builder and handle: `axis` (`SplitAxis`, absent means side_by_side, `effective_axis`), label, accessible description, common state and layout props, `panes` in child order and `Split::MAX_PANES`; panes are ordinary children created with `parent(split_id)`; no divider position and no VALUE_CHANGED handler exist for a Split

Generic AppKit rendering: Split maps to NSSplitView (side_by_side vertical dividers, stacked horizontal); each child is a pane whose layout hints never pull a divider (minimum_size stops a divider, preferred_size and grow seed the lengths until the user moves a divider); a collapsed child collapses its pane and hidden keeps its space; divider positions are local and remembered per Split: a content commit keeps them, a remount restores them, adding or removing a pane keeps the others' proportions, a window resize scales the panes; neither a drag nor an accessibility adjustment originates an interaction or a frame (byte-identical streams with and without resizing); the split group's splitters carry the divider position as value and support increment/decrement; DirtyClassifier makes split_axis structure-affecting and pane hints layout
